messages:
lucy: Noticed a burst of fncall schema errors on route=code-extract in us-central at 05:12 UTC. Customers got 500s.
omar: Is this the new strict validator roll?
lucy: Yes, strict=true rolled at 04:50. Failures look like extra nullable fields and an unexpected `meta` object. Sample from logs:
```json
{"result":"ok","meta":{"source":"scanner"}}
```
tiegan: Our schema expects result:string and tools:[], meta would be ignored in permissive mode. Strict mode treats unknown object as invalid_shape.
omar: How many rejects and billing impact?
ops-bot: fncall.validate.reject count=62 route=code-extract region=us-central severity=hard validation_tag=v3 sample_rate=0.01 billable=false
lucy: Only 1% sampling so console has no payloads. Need on-demand sample button + grouped signature key so we can surface examples without full sampling.
tiegan: Proposal: add signature = hex(trunc(sha256(sorted_keys + error_code))) as a grouping key. Store signature as event label (not Prom metric). Console shows top 3 signatures per route.
omar: Also add a console control to toggle route validation back to permissive for emergency. Ops can gate it with audit log.
lucy: Ops can you flip back while we ship UI?
ops-bot: Emergency toggle executed: route=code-extract validation reverted to permissive at 1768501255. Alerts suppressed for 15m.
tiegan: Telemetry changes: split metrics into fncall.validate.rejects.hard and .soft; keep fncall.validate.rejects.total. Include billable label and validation_tag only on sampled events.
omar: Rollout guidance: don't go 0->100. Re-canary at 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 6-12h windows and metric guards (hard rejects per min, customer error rate).
lucy: Action items: Tiegan PR for signature & storage, Omar PR for metric split/alert rule, Ops to confirm toggle stable, I'll notify support.
ops-bot: Toggle confirmed stable at 1768501256.
lucy: Thanks, will follow up with a short postmortem once we have grouped signatures.
